Abstract

The IT Asset & Support Desk Management System (code-named AssetDesk) is a centralized, enterprise web platform engineered to eliminate inefficiencies, security gaps, and compliance failures common to manual IT inventory tracking and unmonitored helpdesk queues. Organizations routinely encounter misplaced physical hardware, compliance penalties from over-allocated or expired commercial software licenses, and missed resolution timelines due to unmonitored email chains.

To resolve these challenges, a modern three-tier web application was built utilizing the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js). The system enforces strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) across three distinct personas—ADMIN, IT_SUPPORT, and EMPLOYEE—authenticated via JSON Web Tokens (JWT) and encrypted with bcrypt. The architecture comprises five core functional modules: (1) Identity & Access Management with tamper-proof credential updates; (2) Hardware Asset Lifecycle Tracking from procurement to retirement with atomic assignment locks; (3) Software License Management with seat quota enforcement, license key masking, and automated background expiration alert jobs via node-cron; (4) Support Desk Ticketing with a strictly enforced four-stage state machine (OPEN → IN_PROGRESS → RESOLVED → CLOSED) and SLA due-time computation; and (5) Administrative Intelligence featuring an append-only audit log trail, interactive dashboard summaries, and filtered CSV report exports.

System correctness, resilience, and data integrity were verified through an exhaustive test suite comprising 272 automated test cases (256 Jest integration/unit tests across 13 suites and 16 Playwright end-to-end system test journeys), achieving a 100% pass rate with 87.16% statement coverage. The platform demonstrates rapid response times (average latency <10ms on query endpoints) and provides a secure, lightweight, and auditable solution suitable for enterprise and institutional deployment.

Keywords: IT Asset Management, Support Helpdesk, Role-Based Access Control, MERN Architecture, License Expiry Alerts, Immutable Audit Trail.
